sql: CREATE TABLE durable_events (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192), tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('frontend','backend','system')), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192), handler_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(handler_kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192), payload_json BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(payload_json) <= 1048576), payload_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(payload_digest) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), idempotency_identity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(idempotency_identity) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192), actor_identity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(actor_identity) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192), task_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES durable_tasks(id), created_unix_ms BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (created_unix_ms >= 0), UNIQUE(tenant_id,source,kind,idempotency_identity)); CREATE INDEX durable_events_tenant_page ON durable_events(tenant_id,created_unix_ms DESC,id DESC); CREATE TABLE durable_event_replays (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192), event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES durable_events(id), task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES durable_tasks(id), requested_by TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(requested_by) BETWEEN 1 AND 8192), requested_unix_ms BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (requested_unix_ms >= 0), UNIQUE(event_id,id)); CREATE INDEX durable_event_replays_event_page ON durable_event_replays(event_id,requested_unix_ms,id);
